items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: "But is the Silver Leaf band was after the Enola band? No, that was before. ... But Albert Baptiste had it when I was, uh, playing with him."

ctx.x: Let me see. What about Mercedes Fields? Who? Mercedes Fields? Fills?

Gorman Fields, I guess is the name. Mercedes Gorman. Mercedes Gorman, yeah. She played in my band with me. One of them bands, I don't know if it wasn't Enola or the, or the Silver Leaf or one of them. Oh, you had three different bands. Well, yeah, well, Silver Leaf too. But that was, uh, Albert Baptiste was the manager of that. See. Albert Baptiste. What did he say? He was a violin player. Uh huh. And he used to work for one of these corporate companies. But is the Silver Leaf band was after the Enola band? No,…
Oh, that was before. Oh, yeah. First it was Supreme and then the-
